listing.name: VCMI
listing.summary: Play Heroes of Might and Magic III with VCMI’s mods and modern systems support using your own game data.
listing.original_game_title: Heroes of Might and Magic III

steps.title: Use the Windows portable ZIP
steps.instruction: The Windows ZIP contains the client, launcher, map editor and server. Open the extracted folder and start VCMI_launcher.exe to complete upstream setup. The Windows installer remains an alternative.

steps.title: Import your Heroes III data
steps.instruction: In VCMI Launcher, import your GOG offline installer with its matching BIN file, or use your Heroes III Complete or Shadow of Death installation. The launcher handles data import and optional mods.

steps.title: Use the game client for Play
steps.instruction: After setup, finish Portcove registration with VCMI_client.exe and its folder. Keep VCMI Launcher available for mod management and setup. Windows game data, saves and settings normally live in Documents/My Games/vcmi; keep that profile when updating the upstream runtime.

warnings: Heroes III Restoration of Erathia and the HD Edition are not supported; use Complete or Shadow of Death game data.
VCMI saves from different major versions are usually incompatible. Finish ongoing games or keep your current runtime and a profile backup before changing major versions.
